content: Disparities in socioeconomic status, structural inequities, and social determinants of health play a critical role in influencing the management of obesity and diabetes. These disparities can lead to significant differences in health outcomes among various populations. Health care providers are strongly encouraged to evaluate specific factors such as the safety of a patient’s neighborhood, the availability and accessibility of nutritious food options, and the cultural context of the individual. By doing so, clinicians can deliver personalized and effective care strategies that address the unique needs of high-risk groups.
